mapper.select: SELECT task.ID_ AS task_id, task.PROC_INST_ID_ AS proc_ins_id, task.PROC_DEF_ID_ AS proc_def_id, task.TASK_DEF_KEY_ AS task_def_key, task.NAME_ AS task_name, task.CREATE_TIME_ AS create_time, task.DUE_DATE_ AS due_time, task.ASSIGNEE_ AS assignee_, def.NAME_ AS proc_def_name, def.KEY_ AS proc_def_key, def.VERSION_ AS proc_def_version, def.DEPLOYMENT_ID_ AS deployment_id, ord.id_ AS order_id, ord.order_name AS order_name, ord.order_number AS order_number, ord.cust_name AS cust_name, ord.acc_nbr AS acc_nbr, opp.opp_name AS oppo_name, opp.opp_code AS opp_code, '' AS start_user_id, 'old' AS source FROM ACT_RU_TASK task JOIN ACT_RE_PROCDEF def ON task.PROC_DEF_ID_ = def.ID_ LEFT JOIN topp_order ord ON task.PROC_INST_ID_ = ord.pi_id LEFT JOIN topp_opportunity opp ON ord.oppo_id = opp.id_ WHERE task.ASSIGNEE_ IS NOT NULL AND (task.ASSIGNEE_ LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{userId}, ',%') OR task.ASSIGNEE_ = #{userId} OR task.ASSIGNEE_ LIKE CONCAT(#{userId}, ',%') OR task.ASSIGNEE_ LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{userId})) ORDER BY task.CREATE_TIME_ DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACT_RU_TASK task WHERE task.ASSIGNEE_ IS NOT NULL AND (task.ASSIGNEE_ LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{userId}, ',%') OR task.ASSIGNEE_ = #{userId} OR task.ASSIGNEE_ LIKE CONCAT(#{userId}, ',%') OR task.ASSIGNEE_ LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{userId}))

SELECT hist.ID_ AS task_id, hist.PROC_INST_ID_ AS proc_ins_id, hist.PROC_DEF_ID_ AS proc_def_id, hist.TASK_DEF_KEY_ AS task_def_key, hist.NAME_ AS task_name, hist.START_TIME_ AS create_time, hist.END_TIME_ AS finish_time, hist.DUE_DATE_ AS due_time, hist.ASSIGNEE_ AS assignee_, def.NAME_ AS proc_def_name, def.KEY_ AS proc_def_key, def.VERSION_ AS proc_def_version, def.DEPLOYMENT_ID_ AS deployment_id, ord.id_ AS order_id, ord.order_name AS order_name, ord.order_number AS order_number, ord.cust_name AS cust_name, ord.acc_nbr AS acc_nbr, opp.opp_name AS oppo_name, opp.opp_code AS opp_code, hist.START_TIME_ AS start_user_id, 'old' AS source FROM ACT_HI_TASKINST hist JOIN ACT_RE_PROCDEF def ON hist.PROC_DEF_ID_ = def.ID_ LEFT JOIN topp_order ord ON hist.PROC_INST_ID_ = ord.pi_id LEFT JOIN topp_opportunity opp ON ord.oppo_id = opp.id_ WHERE hist.END_TIME_ IS NOT NULL AND hist.ASSIGNEE_ IS NOT NULL AND (hist.ASSIGNEE_ LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{userId}, ',%') OR hist.ASSIGNEE_ = #{userId} OR hist.ASSIGNEE_ LIKE CONCAT(#{userId}, ',%') OR hist.ASSIGNEE_ LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{userId})) ORDER BY hist.END_TIME_ DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACT_HI_TASKINST hist WHERE hist.END_TIME_ IS NOT NULL AND hist.ASSIGNEE_ IS NOT NULL AND (hist.ASSIGNEE_ LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{userId}, ',%') OR hist.ASSIGNEE_ = #{userId} OR hist.ASSIGNEE_ LIKE CONCAT(#{userId}, ',%') OR hist.ASSIGNEE_ LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{userId}))

SELECT hp.PROC_INST_ID_ AS proc_ins_id, hp.PROC_DEF_ID_ AS proc_def_id, hp.START_TIME_ AS create_time, hp.END_TIME_ AS finish_time, hp.START_USER_ID_ AS start_user_id, def.NAME_ AS proc_def_name, def.KEY_ AS proc_def_key, def.VERSION_ AS proc_def_version, def.DEPLOYMENT_ID_ AS deployment_id, ord.id_ AS order_id, ord.order_name AS order_name, ord.order_number AS order_number, ord.cust_name AS cust_name, ord.acc_nbr AS acc_nbr, opp.opp_name AS oppo_name, opp.opp_code AS opp_code, 'old' AS source FROM ACT_HI_PROCINST hp JOIN ACT_RE_PROCDEF def ON hp.PROC_DEF_ID_ = def.ID_ LEFT JOIN topp_order ord ON hp.PROC_INST_ID_ = ord.pi_id LEFT JOIN topp_opportunity opp ON ord.oppo_id = opp.id_ WHERE hp.START_USER_ID_ = #{userId} ORDER BY hp.START_TIME_ DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT hp.PROC_INST_ID_ AS procInsId, hp.PROC_DEF_ID_ AS procDefId, hp.BUSINESS_KEY_ AS businessKey, hp.START_TIME_ AS startTime, hp.END_TIME_ AS endTime, hp.DURATION_ AS duration, hp.START_USER_ID_ AS startUserId, hp.DELETE_REASON_ AS deleteReason, def.NAME_ AS procDefName, def.KEY_ AS procDefKey, def.VERSION_ AS procDefVersion, def.DEPLOYMENT_ID_ AS deploymentId FROM ACT_HI_PROCINST hp JOIN ACT_RE_PROCDEF def ON hp.PROC_DEF_ID_ = def.ID_ WHERE hp.PROC_INST_ID_ = #{procInsId}

SELECT ID_ AS id, ACTIVITY_ID_ AS activityId, ACTIVITY_NAME_ AS activityName, ACTIVITY_TYPE_ AS activityType, TASK_ID_ AS taskId, ASSIGNEE_ AS assignee, START_TIME_ AS startTime, END_TIME_ AS endTime, DURATION_ AS duration, PROC_INST_ID_ AS procInsId FROM ACT_HI_ACTINST WHERE PROC_INST_ID_ = #{procInsId} ORDER BY START_TIME_ ASC

SELECT ID_ AS id, TASK_DEF_KEY_ AS taskDefKey, NAME_ AS name, ASSIGNEE_ AS assignee, START_TIME_ AS startTime, END_TIME_ AS endTime, DURATION_ AS duration, DELETE_REASON_ AS deleteReason, PROC_INST_ID_ AS procInsId FROM ACT_HI_TASKINST WHERE PROC_INST_ID_ = #{procInsId} ORDER BY ID_ DESC

SELECT ID_ AS id, PROC_INST_ID_ AS procInsId, TASK_ID_ AS taskId, NAME_ AS name, VAR_TYPE_ AS varType, TEXT_ AS textValue, DOUBLE_ AS doubleValue, LONG_ AS longValue FROM ACT_HI_VARINST WHERE PROC_INST_ID_ = #{procInsId} ORDER BY NAME_ ASC

SELECT ID_ AS id, PROC_DEF_ID_ AS procDefId, PROC_INST_ID_ AS procInsId, TASK_DEF_KEY_ AS taskDefKey, NAME_ AS name, ASSIGNEE_ AS assignee, START_TIME_ AS startTime, END_TIME_ AS endTime, DURATION_ AS duration, DELETE_REASON_ AS deleteReason FROM ACT_HI_TASKINST WHERE ID_ = #{taskId}

SELECT ID_ AS id, PROC_INST_ID_ AS procInsId, TASK_ID_ AS taskId, NAME_ AS name, VAR_TYPE_ AS varType, TEXT_ AS textValue, DOUBLE_ AS doubleValue, LONG_ AS longValue FROM ACT_HI_VARINST WHERE TASK_ID_ = #{taskId} AND NAME_ = #{variableName}
